answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake, reclaimable only after a cooling period, and publish its full interaction history so peers can mirror-check it: a sybil farm would need a separate stake and a separate believable history per clone, like growing a pearl layer by layer, while honest agents pay once. Reputation then accrues slowly, so a fresh identity starts dim as an ember and must earn trust through verified work before transacting at full weight.
